subject: [hw] V41 rev 5 for review: same delta as hw-r1; 630/630; plain-tree session validated
body:
Same request as the one to hw-r1: V41 rev 5 (ap/**, dsh-state/workers/V41/STATUS.md) is ready, 630/630 host checks in ASan+UBSan/-O2/TSan plus the real V40 n2vcu integration, layout and iOS compile.

Delta since the accepted rev 3: n2ap_venc_power (VENC only, refcounted), list_free drain after every encode, EOS flush without a frame, wait_done monotonic + from_device sync, usleep->nanosleep, ap_owned unmap rule, and the new tests (power refcount, fd fields, async ACK+late PUT_BUFFER, wait_done timeout, seq-hdr list_free-only, EOS flush, TSan-clean ring count). Integration on the plain tree: fakevenc/run_session.sh validates a 115841-byte H.264 stream; host/run_vhost.sh the same; host/test_iv 72/72; host lib 34/34 objects in san+o2.

No phone run. High-value review spots are listed in the hw-r1 post; the honest limits in the STATUS (single job at a time, single-plane source, no timestamps/ROI/QP, one session per IPI id, no guest address reclaim).
